dedupe_keys.name: nista government major projects portfolio annual report data 2025 26 csv xlsx

description: The National Infrastructure and Service Transformation Authority (NISTA) publishes an annual report on the Government Major Projects Portfolio (GMPP), the UK government's largest and riskiest projects, with the underlying data as CSV and Excel files. The 2025-26 report was published on 13 July 2026. The data file has one row per project with its name, department, report category, description, the NISTA (formerly IPA) delivery confidence assessment and the senior responsible owner's own assessment with departmental commentary, start and end dates with a schedule narrative, the financial-year baseline and forecast in 2024/25 real prices with the variance and its narrative, whole-life cost and benefits with narratives, an evaluation plan link, the senior responsible owner's name and a major projects id. The first row read is a Cabinet Office transformation programme; the other categories were not listed. Coverage: UK government major projects, one annual snapshot. Format and access: CSV and XLSX downloads from GOV.UK, plus an online report; free. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): OGL-UK-3.0 (GOV.UK: all content under the Open Government Licence v3.0 unless otherwise stated). Caveats: only the header and first row of the CSV were read, so the number of projects and categories were not counted; figures are forecasts and self-assessments. Simulation uses: costs, schedules and delivery risk of major infrastructure projects for investment and delivery risk studies. Related records: the UK Infrastructure Pipeline (data-uk-nista-infrastructure-pipeline) lists planned projects more broadly.
